{{Current events|year=2025|month=05|day=11|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]]
***Fifteen [[Palestinians]], mostly women and children, are killed in overnight [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]]s across the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/israel-hamas-war/article/israeli-strikes-on-gaza-kill-11-people-mostly-women-and-children/ (CTV News)]
**[[Gaza war hostage crisis]]
***Hamas agrees to release [[Edan Alexander]], a dual [[American-Israeli]] citizen hostage, tomorrow. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/hamas-will-release-israeli-american-hostage-edan-alexander-group-says-2025-05-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Russia]]n [[President of Russia|President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] proposes holding direct negotiations in [[Istanbul]], [[Turkey]], on May 15 after the [[United Kingdom]], [[France]], [[Germany]] and [[Poland]] threatened further sanctions if it does not agree to an unconditional 30-day [[ceasefire]] beginning on May 12. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/putin-proposes-direct-talks-with-ukraine-may-15-2025-05-10/ (Reuters)]
***[[Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] calls on [[Russia]] to confirm an unconditional ceasefire before any direct negotiations between the two nations. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraines-zelenskiy-calls-russia-confirm-ceasefire-before-talks-2025-05-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**At least two police officers are killed and three others are injured in a roadside bombing targeting a police vehicle in [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/bomb-targeting-a-vehicle-carrying-police-killed-2-officers-in-northwest-pakistan/ (CTV News)]
*[[Israeli MIAs]]
**The body of [[Israel Defense Forces]] soldier Zvi Feldman, missing since the [[1982 Lebanon War]], is repatriated to Israel from "deep inside [[Syria]]" in a joint [[Mossad]]–IDF operation. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/body-of-soldier-zvi-feldman-missing-for-nearly-43-years-recovered-by-mossad-and-idf/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-ceasefire-hostages-05-11-2025-6a562aa1c6ce81bcc9ff4649e39ab937 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Mediterranean Sea migrant smuggling]]
**Three people are found dead, including two children, on a [[dinghy]] crossing the [[Mediterranean Sea]] from [[Libya]] to [[Italy]]. German [[non-governmental organization|NGO]] [[RESQSHIP]] intercepts the boat and brings the remaining 59 survivors to [[Lampedusa]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/mediterranean-crossing-at-least-3-die-including-2-children/a-72509717 (DW)]
*A bus carrying [[Buddhism|Buddhist]] [[Pilgrimage|pilgrims]] in [[Kotmale]], [[Sri Lanka]], swerves off a [[cliff]], killing 21 people and injuring 35 others. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/passenger-bus-skids-off-a-cliff-in-sri-lanka-killing-21-people-and-injuring-35/ (CTV News)]
*Five people are killed, dozens are injured including three critically, and hundreds are displaced in a fire at a four-story apartment building in [[Milwaukee]], [[Wisconsin]], United States. [https://wtmj.com/news/2025/05/11/five-dead-three-in-critical-condition-in-milwaukee-apartment-fire/ (WTMJ-TV)] [https://www.cnn.com/2025/05/11/us/milwaukee-apartment-fire (CNN)]
*A runner collapses and later dies near the finish line during running event [[Loop Leeuwarden]] in [[Leeuwarden]], [[Netherlands]], causing the organizers to cancel the event. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2566830-deelnemer-overleden-bij-hardloopevenement-leeuwarden (NOS)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Poland–Russia relations]]
**[[Poland|Polish]] authorities confirm evidences of [[Russia]]n [[sabotage]] behind the [[arson attack]] that destroyed most of the [[Marywilska 44]] [[marketplace]] in [[Warsaw]] in 2024. As a reaction, the Russian [[consulate general]] in [[Kraków]] is ordered to close down. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/may/12/poland-to-close-russian-consulate-krakow-warsaw-shopping-centre-fire/ (''The Guardian'')] [https://apnews.com/article/poland-russia-420187f5755036f6f61c65122c11348f/ (AP)]
*In his first Sunday address, [[Pope Leo XIV]] calls for [[Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine|peace in Ukraine]], the release of all war prisoners and the return of [[Child abductions in the Russo-Ukrainian War|abducted Ukrainian children]] to their families, an immediate [[ceasefire]], the [[Gaza war hostage crisis|release of all hostages]] and the [[Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip (2023–present)|allowance of humanitarian aid]] in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]], as well as a permanent ceasefire to the [[2025 India–Pakistan conflict|India–Pakistan conflict]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/may/11/pope-leo-peace-ukraine-first-sunday-address-never-again-war (''The Guardian'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*The [[Taliban]] bans [[chess]] in [[Afghanistan]], with a Taliban spokesman saying that chess is considered a form of [[Maisir|gambling]] under [[Sharia]] law. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/crk24dz8ne5o (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Albanian parliamentary election]]
**[[Albanians]] vote to elect the 140 members of the [[Parliament of Albania|Parliament]], as [[Prime Minister of Albania|Prime Minister]] [[Edi Rama]] seeks reelection for a fourth term. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/albania-votes-pm-rama-seeks-fourth-term-2025-05-10/ (Reuters)]
